plain.title: Butanol esterification: fixed bed of acid resin at 363 K with a 1:1 feed, about 70 % conversion per pass
plain.when: n-Butanol and acetic acid react to butyl acetate and water on a solid acid; the equilibrium limits one pass.
plain.do: Run a liquid fixed bed of Amberlyst-15 at 363 K and 1:1 (Table 6) and recycle the unreacted acid and butanol (Al-Rabiah et al. 2022).
plain.why: The reaction reaches about 70 % within a short bed; the remaining reactants are recovered downstream (p.11).
plain.check: Butanol 143.1 to 43.2 kmol/h, ester 0.9 to 100.8 kmol/h across the reactor (Table 7, streams 3 and 4).
plain.note: Numbers: Table 6 p.12 (Amberlyst-15, 363 K, 1:1, 284 kPa, 41 m3); p.11 (maximum about 70 %, 69.8 % within about 2.5 m); Table 7 streams 3 and 4 (butanol 143.1 to 43.2 kmol/h, ester 0.9 to 100.8 kmol/h).

decisions.mechanism: Kinetic fixed bed near equilibrium, unreacted reactants recycled.
alternatives: Reactive distillation with a decanter (same paper, >98 %)
limits: Why 363 K was chosen is not stated; Figure 13's kinetic curve peaks near 370-375 K (read from the figure).
The kinetic law's units are not printed.
